hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($in) { $p = $in | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $f = $p.toolCall.args.Path; if ($f -and ($f -like '*.csproj') -and (Test-Path $f) -and (Select-String -Path $f -Pattern 'Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore' -Quiet)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('CRITICAL: Entity Framework Core is strictly prohibited in Socratic ecosystem. Use ScyllaDB!') } }; Write-Output '{}'"
